q: Our verifier asked for a data flow diagram. What should it show?
title: Data flow diagram for a GHG inventory
short: A simple picture of how each emission figure is produced: where the data starts (meter, invoice, register), who records it, where it is stored, how it is calculated and who checks it. One page is enough for a small company. It helps the verifier choose what to test.
audience: MSMEs preparing documents for a verifier

ul: Source: grid power, diesel, coal, refrigerant.
Starting document: bill, invoice, issue register.
How it is converted to CO2, and with which factor.

p: Mark the points where someone checks the data, such as matching bills to payments. Verifiers test these.
Update it when a person, system or supplier changes.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements
